TITLE: Jira
UNAVAILABLE: The Jira integration is not loaded on this server (JIRA_ENABLED is off).
NOT_CONFIGURED: The Jira OAuth app is not configured on this server (JIRA_CLIENT_ID, JIRA_CLIENT_SECRET, the callback URL). Nobody can connect until it is.

CONNECT.TITLE: Connect your Jira Cloud site
CONNECT.TEXT: You will authorize this platform with Atlassian and come back here. Then map Jira projects to projects, import their issues as tasks, and keep them in sync.

CALLBACK_ERRORS.not_configured: The Jira OAuth app is not configured on this server.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.denied: Atlassian did not authorize the connection.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.invalid_state: The connect flow expired or was already used. Start it again.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.exchange_failed: Atlassian refused the authorization code. Start the flow again.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.site_unreadable: The Jira sites of your account could not be read after authorizing.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.no_site: Your Atlassian account reaches no Jira Cloud site this app may use.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.site_mismatch: This connection has mappings on a Jira site your Atlassian account no longer reaches, so it was kept as it was. Connect with an account that reaches that site, or remove the mappings first.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.not_saved: The connection could not be saved.

REASONS.token_refused: Atlassian refused the token. Connect again.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Jira settings
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect Jira from this organization? The mappings and the site's webhook go; the imported tasks stay.

SITES.TITLE: Jira site
SITES.REQUIRED: Your Atlassian account reaches several Jira sites. Choose the one this connection works with: nothing syncs until you do.
SITES.CHOSEN: The connection now works with this site.
SITES.EMPTY: The connection's token reaches no Jira site. Connect again.
SITES.LOCKED: A connection with mappings keeps its site, since a mapping names its Jira project by an id that only this site knows. Remove the mappings to choose another site.

WEBHOOK.TITLE: Webhook
WEBHOOK.INTRO: Jira delivers the changes of the mapped projects to this server through one webhook per connection. Jira expires it after 30 days; the server renews it before then. Without it, the scheduled import picks the changes up.
WEBHOOK.ACTIVE: Registered; Jira keeps it until {{ date }}.

OUTCOMES.off: No webhook is used: webhooks are off on this server, or the connection has no site yet or waits for a reconnect. The scheduled import follows Jira instead.
OUTCOMES.unchanged: The webhook was already in line with the mappings (none is needed while no mapping brings issues in).
OUTCOMES.removed: The webhook was removed: no mapping brings issues in.
OUTCOMES.failed: The webhook could not be registered; see the error above.

MAPPINGS.TITLE: Jira projects and projects
MAPPINGS.INTRO: Each Jira project maps to one project. Inbound brings the Jira project's issues in as tasks; outbound sends the project's tasks to the Jira project (one outbound mapping per project).
MAPPINGS.EMPTY: No Jira project is mapped yet.
MAPPINGS.STATUS_MAP_HINT: The task status name an issue gets for each Jira status category. A blank one keeps the default.
MAPPINGS.NAMED_STATUSES_HINT: A Jira status can also map on its own, which wins over its category. Leave it blank to follow its category.
MAPPINGS.ISSUE_TYPES_HINT: Bring in only these issue types. None checked brings every type in.
MAPPINGS.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this mapping? The imported tasks stay.
MAPPINGS.IMPORT_STARTED: The import started; see the runs below.
MAPPINGS.NO_JIRA_PROJECTS: The site has no project the connection can see.

RUNS.TITLE: Runs
RUNS.SHOW_CONFLICTS: List the conflicts this run found
RUNS.REPORT_LINE: {{ issues }} issues on {{ pages }} pages; {{ comments }} comments, {{ links }} links
RUNS.REPORT_PARTIAL: Stopped early: the next import continues from where it stopped.

CONFLICTS.TITLE: Sync conflicts
CONFLICTS.INTRO: A field changed both in Jira and on the platform since they last agreed. Jira's value was applied to the task, and the task's value is kept here: keep Jira's value, or restore the task's (a mapping that sends changes out sends it to the issue too).
CONFLICTS.KEPT_EXTERNAL: Resolved: the task keeps the value it has now.
CONFLICTS.KEPT_PLATFORM: The task's value was written back.

ERRORS.STALE: The task changed since the conflict was found, so its value was not written back. Keep Jira's value, or edit the task.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This conflict was resolved already; the list was read again.
